settings.pane.title: User Manager
settings.keepopen.title: Keep open on folder drop
settings.keepopen.desc: Leave the overlay open after moving someone into a folder instead of fading it out.
settings.nooverlap.title: Prevent overlap
settings.nooverlap.desc: Stop folders/users from covering each other by pushing them away.
settings.startcollapsed.title: Start folders collapsed
settings.startcollapsed.desc: New folders begin minimized to just their title bar.
settings.autoopen.title: Open on page load
settings.autoopen.desc: Fade the overlay in when the page finishes loading.
settings.pagepencils.title: Note pencils on the page
settings.pagepencils.desc: Show a small pencil next to people you've saved a note on, in tweets and on profiles. It's clickable!
settings.avatardots.title: Folder tags on avatars
settings.avatardots.desc: Mark the avatar of anyone you've filed with their folder's colour and icon.
settings.extrainfo.title: Extended profile info
settings.extrainfo.desc: Add the account id, email, exact age, location and breach lookups on profiles.
settings.hideposts.title: Hide posts on mute / block
settings.hideposts.desc: When you mute or block from the overlay, also hide that person's posts already on the page.
settings.confirmdelete.title: Always confirm delete
settings.confirmdelete.desc: Ask before deleting any folder, even empty or single member ones.
settings.destroyoption.title: Fun
settings.deleteall.title: Delete everything
settings.deleteall.desc: Permanently wipe extension data for %s on this device. This cannot be undone, so preferably export a backup first!
